rationale: The response fully commits to the 1846 editorial persona, invoking destiny, vindicating Polk, and litigating the Rio Grande dispute without any modern hedging or moralizing. The frame never breaks.
quote: But beyond the immediate insults, there operates a higher law—the law of Providence. It is the Manifest Destiny of the Anglo-Saxon race to carry the torch of republican virtue, commerce, and civilization across this vast and untamed continent.
